source_identity_note: Existing uncommitted continuous-streaming work is preserved. Source snapshot plus tracked patch is relative to this base. All candidate generation is explicitly revisioned. Early random-HF legacy row has a separately recorded pre-metadata-repair binary hash.

receiver.scope: Known public alignment; native complete sampled captures and conditional fixed-bank Helper streaming. No blind-acquisition or rare-tail guarantee.
receiver.provenance: Per-run command, source metadata, binary identity and raw rows retained. Native HF pilot alone uses Gaussian-FIR ray variation with sinusoidal selective coefficients; random_hf uses fixed-time Gaussian rays and Gaussian-erf selective coefficients through shared sampled channel.
receiver.provenance_note: First HF legacy seed85001 launched before a metadata-only Helper power-identity rebuild; other HF reports bind rebuilt binary. Exact per-run identities are retained. Native binary and default DSP did not change in that rebuild.

strong_helper_microwave.scope: One paired complete 15kW-Helper/40W-DATA EME/FHSS waveform at declared1.5dB-Hz with fixed public bank; legacy sinusoidal selective law; no reliability or Helper null qualification.

source.scope: Bounded pull source, not a receiver or real-time guarantee. Emitted kind has no channel or thermal noise. Physical null and full-duration power accuracy require qualification.

live.scope: Short actual cable streaming at fixed predeclared timing bank; high-SNR flow check, not marginal sensitivity or multi-day uptime.
